title: Frontier exploration C: barrier inversion map; integer structure is the only unconstrained resource
question: Frontier C (barrier inversion): barrier map of 11 lab barriers with exact assumptions; the only resource none constrains is integer structure of coordinate representatives (order, bits, size, factorization). Transplanted mechanisms (NFS, FFS, quasi-polynomial small-characteristic, class groups, BKW/lattice) all need a size function or computable quotient chain compatible with the group law, or an algebraic factor base with fast decomposition; E(F_p) has neither. Tests: (C1) lattice decomposition of Semaev S_3 reaches alpha ~ 0.05-0.10 (analytic limit -> 1/6) vs alpha >= 1/2 needed — killed; (C3) smoothness-type predicate spectra null in two seeds with controls. C2 (Miller orbit cocycle) and C4 (xedni) killed by derivation/literature; C5 (comparison-augmented decision trees) open.
